title: Yellow Peppery Middle Eastern Eggs Knafeh
description: A peppery and pillowy Middle Eastern dish featuring eggs, perfect for a sick day, made with a pressure cooker and high in protein. This knafeh-style dish is a unique twist on traditional Middle Eastern cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, sugar, black pepper, and salt until well combined.
Add the melted butter, akawi cheese, and chopped parsley to the bowl and stir until the cheese is fully incorporated.
Layer the shredded phyllo dough in a 9-inch springform pan, brushing each layer with a little bit of melted butter.
Pour the egg mixture over the phyllo dough and smooth the top.
Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the knafeh from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Use a pressure cooker to cook the knafeh for 10 minutes, then let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, if desired, for a quicker cooking time.
